zh.mech: 气行不畅，血行受阻，瘀血内停，不通则痛，故见固定刺痛、舌质紫暗。
zh.cause: 长期情志不畅、久坐、外伤或寒凝。
zh.cchar: 肤色晦暗，易有瘀斑，痛处固定，口唇偏暗。
zh.ctend: 易患头痛、痛经、心血管问题。
zh.inquiry: 肩颈和后背固定位置刺痛，夜间更明显，面色发暗，月经有血块。
zh.tongue: 舌质紫暗，有瘀点，舌下络脉怒张。
zh.summary: 气滞日久导致血瘀，固定刺痛、舌紫暗有瘀点、舌下络脉怒张和涩脉均为血瘀典型表现。\n治以活血化瘀、行气止痛，配合温和运动与保暖，通常3至4周疼痛减轻、面色改善。
zh.rationale: 痛处固定、夜间加重、舌紫暗瘀点及涩脉相互印证瘀血内阻。
good: 红糖姜茶 - 温经散寒
avoid: 冰冷饮食 - 凝滞血脉
油炸肥腻 - 阻滞气血
久坐不动 - 加重瘀滞
recipes: 山楂红糖茶：山楂10g、红糖适量，煮水饮用。
points: 血海 - 髌骨内上缘上二寸，按揉活血
膈俞 - 第7胸椎旁，温灸
合谷 - 手背虎口，按揉止痛
exercise: 颈肩拉伸操，每日2次
游泳或慢走，每周4次
zh.emotion: 放松心情，疼痛时配合深呼吸缓解紧张。
zh.dosage: 水煎服，每日一剂，分两次温服
zh.note: 活血药与抗凝药合用需医生评估。
zh.fu_improve: 疼痛减轻，面色红润，经血块减少
zh.fu_next: 根据舌下络脉变化调整活血药

en.mech: Sluggish Qi impedes blood flow so stasis forms; where there is obstruction there is pain, giving fixed stabbing pain and a dusky tongue.
en.cause: Long-term emotional strain, prolonged sitting, injury or cold congealing.
en.cchar: Dull complexion, easy bruising, fixed pain, dusky lips.
en.ctend: Prone to headaches, painful periods and cardiovascular issues.
en.inquiry: Fixed stabbing pain in my neck and upper back, worse at night, dull complexion and clots in my periods.
en.tongue: Dusky purple tongue with spots and distended sublingual veins.
en.summary: Long-standing Qi stagnation has led to blood stasis. Fixed stabbing pain, a dusky spotted tongue, distended sublingual veins and a choppy pulse are the classic picture.\nTreatment invigorates blood, moves Qi and relieves pain, supported by gentle movement and warmth. Pain and complexion usually improve in 3 to 4 weeks.
en.rationale: Fixed pain worse at night, a dusky spotted tongue and a choppy pulse corroborate blood stasis.
en.principle: Invigorate blood, dispel stasis, move Qi and relieve pain
en.method: Regulate Qi, invigorate blood, unblock collaterals
good: Black fungus - moves blood and moistens the lung
Rose buds - move Qi and blood
Brown sugar ginger tea - warms the channels
avoid: Iced food and drinks - congeal blood
Fried, greasy food - obstruct Qi and blood
Prolonged sitting - worsens stasis
recipes: Hawthorn brown sugar tea: 10g hawthorn simmered with a little brown sugar.
life: Keep neck and shoulders warm, avoid cold draughts
Apply a warm compress to painful areas for 15 minutes daily
points: Xuehai (SP10) - above the inner knee, press to move blood
Geshu (BL17) - mild moxibustion
Hegu (LI4) - web of the hand, press to relieve pain
exercise: Neck and shoulder stretches twice a day
Swimming or walking 4 times a week
en.emotion: Stay relaxed and use deep breathing when pain flares.
en.purpose: Invigorates blood, dispels stasis, relieves pain
en.dosage: Decoct, one dose daily in two warm portions
warn: Sudden chest pain or limb weakness
contra: Blood-invigorating herbs are contraindicated in pregnancy
en.note: Combining blood-invigorating herbs with anticoagulants needs clinician assessment.
en.fu_improve: Less pain, healthier colour, fewer clots
en.fu_next: Adjust blood-moving herbs by sublingual vein changes

ms.mech: Qi yang tersekat menghalang aliran darah sehingga darah beku; kerana ada sekatan maka timbul sakit tetap seperti ditusuk dan lidah kebiruan.
ms.cause: Tekanan emosi lama, duduk lama, kecederaan atau sejuk.
ms.cchar: Kulit suram, mudah lebam, sakit di tempat tetap, bibir gelap.
ms.ctend: Mudah sakit kepala, senggugut dan masalah kardiovaskular.
ms.inquiry: Sakit seperti ditusuk di leher dan belakang atas, lebih teruk waktu malam, muka suram dan haid berketul.
ms.tongue: Lidah kebiruan dengan bintik dan urat bawah lidah membengkak.
ms.face: Muka suram dengan bayang gelap sekeliling mata.
ms.summary: Genangan Qi yang lama membawa kepada pembekuan darah. Sakit tetap seperti ditusuk, lidah kebiruan berbintik, urat bawah lidah membengkak dan nadi kasar ialah gambaran klasik.\nRawatan melancarkan darah, menggerakkan Qi dan melegakan sakit dengan pergerakan lembut dan kehangatan. Sakit dan seri muka biasanya bertambah baik dalam 3 hingga 4 minggu.
ms.rationale: Sakit tetap yang teruk waktu malam, lidah kebiruan berbintik dan nadi kasar menyokong pembekuan darah.
ms.principle: Lancarkan darah, buang beku, gerakkan Qi
ms.method: Atur Qi, lancarkan darah, buka saluran
good: Kuntum ros - menggerakkan Qi dan darah
Teh halia gula merah - menghangatkan saluran
avoid: Makanan dan minuman ais - membekukan darah
Makanan goreng berminyak - menghalang Qi
Duduk lama - memburukkan pembekuan
recipes: Teh hawthorn gula merah: 10g hawthorn direbus dengan sedikit gula merah.
life: Tuam suam tempat sakit 15 minit sehari
points: Xuehai (SP10) - atas lutut dalam, urut melancarkan darah
Geshu (BL17) - moksibusi ringan
Hegu (LI4) - celah ibu jari dan telunjuk, tekan untuk legakan sakit
exercise: Regangan leher dan bahu dua kali sehari
Berenang atau berjalan 4 kali seminggu
ms.emotion: Kekal santai dan gunakan pernafasan dalam apabila sakit.
ms.formula: Xue Fu Zhu Yu Tang (diubah suai)
ms.purpose: Melancarkan darah, buang beku, legakan sakit
ms.dosage: Rebus, satu dos sehari dalam dua bahagian suam
warn: Sakit dada mendadak atau anggota lemah
contra: Herba pelancar darah dilarang ketika hamil
Rujuk dahulu jika mengambil ubat pencair darah
ms.note: Gabungan herba pelancar darah dengan antikoagulan perlu dinilai doktor.
ms.fu_improve: Sakit berkurang, seri muka pulih, ketulan haid berkurang
ms.fu_next: Laras herba mengikut perubahan urat bawah lidah

zh.mech: 肾阳亏虚，命门火衰，温煦失职，故见畏寒肢冷、腰膝酸冷、夜尿频多。
zh.cause: 年高体弱、久病、过食寒凉、房劳。
zh.cchar: 畏寒怕冷，手脚冰凉，精神不振，大便溏。
zh.ctend: 易患关节冷痛、水肿、性功能减退。
zh.inquiry: 特别怕冷，腰膝发冷酸软，夜里要起夜两三次，手脚常年冰凉。
zh.summary: 肾阳不足、命门火衰为主，畏寒、腰膝冷、夜尿多与舌淡胖、沉迟脉一致。\n治以温补肾阳、固摄下元，配合保暖与温热饮食，通常4至6周怕冷与夜尿明显改善。
zh.rationale: 畏寒肢冷、夜尿频多、舌淡胖苔白滑、脉沉迟共同指向肾阳虚。
good: 生姜红枣茶 - 温中散寒
avoid: 冰饮冷食 - 伤阳
苦寒药茶 - 损伤阳气
长期吹冷气 - 寒邪入侵
recipes: 当归生姜羊肉汤：羊肉200g、当归10g、生姜5片，炖1.5小时。
points: 关元 - 脐下三寸，温灸15分钟
命门 - 腰部第2腰椎下，温灸或热敷
涌泉 - 足底前三分之一，按揉助温阳
exercise: 八段锦、太极，每日30分钟
中午前后快走，微微出汗即可
zh.emotion: 阳虚者常情绪低落，多接触阳光与社交。
zh.dosage: 水煎服，每日一剂，分两次温服
warn: 下肢明显水肿或尿量骤减
zh.note: 温阳药需由医生根据体质决定剂量。
zh.fu_improve: 手脚转暖，夜尿减少，精神好转
zh.fu_next: 视寒象消退逐步减少温热药

en.mech: Declining Kidney yang and Life Gate fire fail to warm the body, giving cold intolerance, cold sore lower back and knees and frequent night urination.
en.cause: Ageing, long illness, excess cold food, overexertion.
en.cchar: Aversion to cold, cold hands and feet, low spirit, loose stools.
en.ctend: Prone to cold joint pain, oedema and lowered vitality.
en.inquiry: I feel the cold a lot, my lower back and knees are cold and sore, I wake two or three times at night to urinate and my hands and feet are always icy.
en.tongue: Pale swollen tongue with a white slippery coat.
en.summary: Kidney yang deficiency with declining Life Gate fire is central. Cold intolerance, cold sore lower back and nocturia match a pale swollen tongue and deep slow pulse.\nTreatment warms and tonifies Kidney yang and secures the lower burner, supported by warmth and warm foods. Cold intolerance and nocturia usually improve markedly in 4 to 6 weeks.
en.rationale: Cold limbs, nocturia, a pale swollen slippery tongue and a deep slow pulse jointly indicate Kidney yang deficiency.
en.principle: Warm and tonify Kidney yang, secure the lower burner
en.method: Warm the Kidney, assist yang, replenish essence
good: Walnuts - tonify Kidney and warm the lung
Ginger and red date tea - warms the middle
avoid: Iced drinks and food - injure yang
Bitter, cold herbal teas - damage yang
Long exposure to air-conditioning - lets cold in
recipes: Angelica ginger lamb soup: 200g lamb, 10g dang gui, 5 slices ginger, stewed 1.5 hours.
life: Keep the lower back, abdomen and feet warm
points: Guanyuan (CV4) - three finger-widths below the navel, warm with moxa for 15 minutes
Mingmen (GV4) - lower back, moxa or hot pack
Yongquan (KI1) - sole of the foot, press to warm yang
exercise: Baduanjin or tai chi, 30 minutes daily
Brisk midday walk to a light sweat
en.emotion: Yang deficiency often brings low mood; seek sunlight and social contact.
en.purpose: Warms Kidney yang and transforms Qi to move fluids
en.dosage: Decoct, one dose daily in two warm portions
warn: Marked leg swelling or sudden drop in urine output
en.note: Warming herbs should be dosed by a clinician according to constitution.
en.fu_improve: Warmer hands and feet, less nocturia, better energy
en.fu_next: Taper warming herbs as cold signs recede

ms.mech: Yang Buah Pinggang dan api Pintu Hayat yang menurun gagal menghangatkan badan, menyebabkan takut sejuk, pinggang dan lutut sejuk serta kerap kencing malam.
ms.cause: Usia tua, sakit lama, terlalu banyak makanan sejuk, keletihan.
ms.cchar: Takut sejuk, tangan kaki sejuk, semangat lemah, najis lembik.
ms.ctend: Mudah sakit sendi sejuk, bengkak dan tenaga menurun.
ms.inquiry: Sangat takut sejuk, pinggang dan lutut sejuk dan lenguh, bangun dua tiga kali waktu malam untuk kencing, tangan kaki sentiasa sejuk.
ms.tongue: Lidah pucat bengkak, salutan putih licin.
ms.summary: Kekurangan yang Buah Pinggang dengan api Pintu Hayat menurun ialah punca utama. Takut sejuk, pinggang sejuk dan kerap kencing malam sepadan dengan lidah pucat bengkak dan nadi dalam perlahan.\nRawatan menghangatkan yang Buah Pinggang dan menguatkan bahagian bawah, bersama kehangatan dan makanan suam. Takut sejuk dan kencing malam biasanya bertambah baik dalam 4 hingga 6 minggu.
ms.rationale: Anggota sejuk, kencing malam, lidah pucat licin dan nadi dalam perlahan bersama menunjukkan kekurangan yang Buah Pinggang.
ms.principle: Hangatkan dan tambah yang Buah Pinggang
ms.method: Hangatkan Buah Pinggang, bantu yang, penuhi intisari
good: Teh halia dan kurma merah - menghangatkan pertengahan
avoid: Minuman dan makanan ais - merosakkan yang
Teh herba pahit sejuk - merosakkan yang
Terlalu lama dalam aircond - sejuk masuk
recipes: Sup kambing dang gui halia: 200g kambing, 10g dang gui, 5 keping halia, reneh 1.5 jam.
life: Pastikan pinggang, perut dan kaki hangat
Rendam kaki air panas sebelum tidur
points: Guanyuan (CV4) - tiga jari bawah pusat, moksibusi 15 minit
Mingmen (GV4) - pinggang, moksa atau tuam panas
Yongquan (KI1) - tapak kaki, urut menghangatkan
exercise: Baduanjin atau tai chi 30 minit sehari
Berjalan pantas tengah hari hingga sedikit berpeluh
ms.emotion: Kekurangan yang sering membawa murung; cari cahaya matahari dan bergaul.
ms.formula: Jin Gui Shen Qi Wan (diubah suai)
ms.dosage: Rebus, satu dos sehari dalam dua bahagian suam
warn: Kaki bengkak ketara atau air kencing tiba-tiba berkurang
contra: Tidak sesuai untuk kekurangan yin dengan panas
ms.note: Herba penghangat perlu ditentukan dos oleh doktor mengikut jenis badan.
ms.fu_improve: Tangan kaki lebih hangat, kurang kencing malam, tenaga baik
ms.fu_next: Kurangkan herba penghangat apabila tanda sejuk reda

zh.mech: 思虑过度暗耗心血、损伤脾气，气血生化不足，心神失养，故见心悸健忘、多梦、乏力。
zh.cause: 长期思虑劳倦、饮食不节、产后或病后失养。
zh.cchar: 面色淡白，唇淡，心悸，头晕，容易疲倦。
zh.ctend: 易患失眠、贫血样表现、记忆力减退。
zh.inquiry: 常心悸，记忆力变差，晚上多梦易醒，白天没精神，食欲一般。
zh.summary: 思虑伤及心脾，气血化源不足，心神失养。心悸、健忘多梦、乏力与舌淡、脉细弱互相呼应。\n治以补益心脾、养血安神，配合规律作息和温补饮食，通常3至5周睡眠和精神改善。
zh.rationale: 心悸多梦健忘属心血不足；食少乏力属脾气虚；舌淡脉细弱为气血两虚之象。
good: 猪心 - 以形补形，养心
avoid: 浓茶咖啡 - 扰神耗血
生冷 - 伤脾阳
熬夜 - 暗耗阴血
recipes: 桂圆红枣茶：桂圆10g、红枣5枚、枸杞5g，热水焖15分钟。
life: 固定作息，中午小憩20分钟
晚饭清淡，睡前不看刺激内容
减少过度思虑，记下待办事项以放空大脑
points: 神门 - 腕横纹尺侧，按揉助眠
内关 - 腕上二寸，按揉宁心
足三里 - 健脾益气
exercise: 散步、太极，每日30分钟
睡前拉伸与腹式呼吸
zh.emotion: 放下过度思虑，尝试正念冥想。
zh.dosage: 水煎服，每日一剂，分两次温服
zh.note: 心悸持续建议做心电图检查。
zh.fu_improve: 心悸减少，睡眠更稳，精神好转

en.mech: Excessive worry consumes Heart blood and injures Spleen Qi; with weakened Qi and blood generation the spirit is not nourished, causing palpitations, poor memory, dreams and fatigue.
en.cause: Chronic overthinking, irregular meals, poor recovery after childbirth or illness.
en.cchar: Pale complexion and lips, palpitations, dizziness, easy fatigue.
en.ctend: Prone to insomnia, anaemia-like features and poor memory.
en.inquiry: Frequent palpitations, my memory is worse, vivid dreams and waking easily at night, tired in the daytime with an average appetite.
en.tongue: Pale tongue with a thin white coat.
en.summary: Overthinking has injured the Heart and Spleen, depleting the source of Qi and blood and leaving the spirit unnourished. Palpitations, poor memory, vivid dreams and fatigue match a pale tongue and thready weak pulse.\nTreatment tonifies the Heart and Spleen and nourishes blood to calm the spirit, with regular routines and warm nourishing foods. Sleep and energy usually improve in 3 to 5 weeks.
en.rationale: Palpitations, dreams and forgetfulness reflect Heart blood deficiency; poor appetite and fatigue reflect Spleen Qi deficiency; pale tongue and thready pulse confirm Qi-blood deficiency.
en.principle: Tonify Heart and Spleen, nourish blood and calm the spirit
en.method: Boost Qi, supplement blood, fortify the Spleen and nourish the Heart
good: Longan - nourishes blood and calms the spirit
avoid: Strong tea and coffee - disturb the spirit
Cold raw food - injures Spleen yang
Late nights - consume yin and blood
recipes: Longan and red date tea: 10g longan, 5 red dates, 5g goji berries steeped in hot water for 15 minutes.
life: Keep fixed hours and nap 20 minutes at noon
Light dinner, no stimulating content before bed
Write down to-do items to empty the mind
points: Shenmen (HT7) - wrist crease on the ulnar side, press to aid sleep
Neiguan (PC6) - two finger-widths above the wrist, calms the Heart
Zusanli (ST36) - strengthens Spleen Qi
exercise: Walking or tai chi, 30 minutes daily
Pre-sleep stretching and abdominal breathing
en.emotion: Let go of excessive rumination; try mindfulness meditation.
en.purpose: Boosts Qi, supplements blood, fortifies the Spleen and nourishes the Heart
en.dosage: Decoct, one dose daily in two warm portions
warn: Palpitations with chest pain or fainting
en.fu_improve: Fewer palpitations, steadier sleep, better energy
en.fu_next: Taper as Qi and blood recover

ms.mech: Terlalu banyak risau menghabiskan darah Jantung dan melemahkan Qi Limpa; penghasilan Qi dan darah berkurang sehingga semangat tidak dipelihara, menyebabkan debar, pelupa, mimpi banyak dan letih.
ms.cause: Terlalu banyak berfikir, makan tidak teratur, pemulihan lemah selepas bersalin atau sakit.
ms.cchar: Muka dan bibir pucat, debar, pening, mudah letih.
ms.ctend: Mudah insomnia, tanda seperti anemia dan ingatan lemah.
ms.inquiry: Kerap berdebar, ingatan semakin lemah, banyak mimpi dan mudah terjaga waktu malam, siang tidak bermaya dan selera biasa.
ms.summary: Terlalu banyak berfikir telah menjejaskan Jantung dan Limpa, mengurangkan punca Qi dan darah. Debar, pelupa, mimpi banyak dan letih sepadan dengan lidah pucat dan nadi halus lemah.\nRawatan menambah Jantung dan Limpa serta menyuburkan darah untuk menenangkan semangat, bersama rutin teratur dan makanan suam berkhasiat. Tidur dan tenaga biasanya bertambah baik dalam 3 hingga 5 minggu.
ms.rationale: Debar, mimpi dan pelupa menunjukkan darah Jantung kurang; selera dan letih menunjukkan Qi Limpa kurang; lidah pucat nadi halus mengesahkan.
ms.principle: Tambah Jantung dan Limpa, subur darah, tenangkan semangat
ms.method: Tambah Qi, tambah darah, kuatkan Limpa
avoid: Teh pekat dan kopi - mengganggu semangat
Makanan sejuk mentah - merosakkan Limpa
Berjaga malam - menghabiskan darah
recipes: Teh longan dan kurma merah: 10g longan, 5 kurma merah, 5g goji, rendam air panas 15 minit.
life: Waktu tidur tetap dan tidur sebentar 20 minit tengah hari
Makan malam ringan, elak kandungan merangsang sebelum tidur
Catat senarai tugas supaya fikiran kosong
points: Shenmen (HT7) - lipatan pergelangan sisi ulna, urut membantu tidur
Neiguan (PC6) - dua jari atas pergelangan, menenangkan Jantung
Zusanli (ST36) - menguatkan Qi Limpa
exercise: Berjalan atau tai chi 30 minit sehari
Regangan dan pernafasan perut sebelum tidur
ms.emotion: Lepaskan risau berlebihan; cuba meditasi kesedaran.
ms.purpose: Menambah Qi dan darah, menguatkan Limpa
ms.dosage: Rebus, satu dos sehari dalam dua bahagian suam
warn: Debar dengan sakit dada atau pitam
ms.fu_improve: Kurang debar, tidur lebih stabil, tenaga baik
ms.fu_next: Kurangkan dos apabila Qi dan darah pulih

zh.mech: 肝肾阴精不足，髓海失养，虚阳上扰，故见头晕耳鸣、腰膝酸软、失眠健忘。
zh.cause: 年高体衰、久病、房劳、长期熬夜。
zh.cchar: 头晕耳鸣，腰膝酸软，口燥咽干，视物昏花。
zh.ctend: 易患高血压、骨质疏松、更年期综合征。
zh.inquiry: 长期睡不好，经常耳鸣头晕，腰膝酸软无力，眼睛干涩看东西模糊。
zh.summary: 肝肾阴虚，虚阳上扰。耳鸣头晕、腰膝酸软、失眠与舌红少苔有裂、细弦脉互相印证。\n治以滋补肝肾、潜阳安神，配合早睡与滋养饮食，通常4至6周耳鸣与睡眠改善。
zh.rationale: 耳鸣腰酸为肾阴虚；眼干头晕为肝阴虚；舌红少苔裂纹及细弦脉为阴虚阳亢。
good: 黑芝麻 - 补肝肾，益精血
枸杞 - 滋补肝肾，明目
avoid: 辛辣燥热 - 耗阴
熬夜 - 暗耗肾精
过量咖啡 - 扰神伤阴
recipes: 黑芝麻枸杞粥：黑芝麻20g、枸杞10g、粳米80g，煮粥。
life: 避免长时间用眼，定时远眺
保持腰部保暖，不过度劳累
points: 太溪 - 滋肾阴
三阴交 - 养阴安神
太冲 - 平肝潜阳
exercise: 太极、八段锦，每日20至30分钟
缓步行走，避免剧烈运动
zh.emotion: 保持平静，避免情绪激动以免虚阳上扰。
zh.dosage: 水煎服，每日一剂，分两次温服
warn: 突发剧烈头痛或视力骤降

en.mech: Insufficient Liver and Kidney essence leaves the marrow sea unnourished and lets deficient yang float upward, causing dizziness, tinnitus, weak lower back and knees, insomnia and poor memory.
en.cause: Ageing, long illness, overexertion, chronic late nights.
en.cchar: Dizziness, tinnitus, sore weak lower back and knees, dry mouth and blurred vision.
en.ctend: Prone to hypertension, osteoporosis and menopausal symptoms.
en.inquiry: Sleeping badly for a long time, frequent ringing in the ears and dizziness, weak sore lower back and knees, dry eyes and blurry vision.
en.tongue: Red tongue with scanty coat and cracks.
en.summary: Liver and Kidney yin deficiency with floating yang. Tinnitus, dizziness, weak lower back and insomnia match a red cracked tongue with scanty coat and a thready wiry pulse.\nTreatment enriches Liver and Kidney yin and anchors yang to calm the spirit, with earlier sleep and nourishing foods. Tinnitus and sleep usually improve in 4 to 6 weeks.
en.rationale: Tinnitus and lower back weakness reflect Kidney yin deficiency; dry eyes and dizziness reflect Liver yin deficiency; the tongue and pulse show yin deficiency with yang hyperactivity.
en.principle: Enrich Liver and Kidney, anchor yang, calm the spirit
en.method: Nourish water to moisten wood, subdue Liver yang
good: Black sesame - tonifies Liver and Kidney
Goji berries - nourish Liver and Kidney, brighten eyes
avoid: Spicy and drying food - consume yin
Late nights - drain Kidney essence
Excess coffee - disturbs spirit
recipes: Black sesame and goji congee: 20g black sesame, 10g goji, 80g rice.
life: Limit prolonged eye strain and look into the distance regularly
Keep the lower back warm and avoid overexertion
points: Taixi (KI3) - nourishes Kidney yin
Sanyinjiao (SP6) - nourishes yin and calms the spirit
Taichong (LR3) - subdues Liver yang
exercise: Tai chi or Baduanjin, 20 to 30 minutes daily
Gentle walking, avoid strenuous exercise
en.emotion: Stay calm; strong emotion can stir floating yang.
en.purpose: Enriches Liver and Kidney yin and brightens the eyes
en.dosage: Decoct, one dose daily in two warm portions
warn: Sudden severe headache or abrupt vision loss
en.note: People with hypertension should monitor blood pressure alongside treatment.
en.fu_improve: Less tinnitus, better sleep, stronger lower back
en.fu_next: Adjust yin-nourishing herbs as yin recovers

ms.mech: Intisari Hati dan Buah Pinggang yang kurang tidak memelihara otak dan membiarkan yang terapung ke atas, menyebabkan pening, telinga berdengung, pinggang dan lutut lemah serta tidak boleh tidur.
ms.cause: Usia tua, sakit lama, keletihan, berjaga malam kronik.
ms.cchar: Pening, tinitus, pinggang dan lutut lemah, mulut kering, penglihatan kabur.
ms.ctend: Mudah darah tinggi, osteoporosis dan gejala putus haid.
ms.inquiry: Lama tidak boleh tidur nyenyak, telinga kerap berdengung dan pening, pinggang dan lutut lemah, mata kering dan kabur.
ms.tongue: Lidah merah, salutan sedikit dan retak.
ms.summary: Kekurangan yin Hati dan Buah Pinggang dengan yang terapung. Tinitus, pening, pinggang lemah dan insomnia sepadan dengan lidah merah retak dan nadi halus tegang.\nRawatan menambah yin Hati dan Buah Pinggang serta menurunkan yang untuk menenangkan semangat, bersama tidur awal dan makanan berkhasiat. Tinitus dan tidur biasanya baik dalam 4 hingga 6 minggu.
ms.rationale: Tinitus dan pinggang lemah menunjukkan yin Buah Pinggang kurang; mata kering dan pening menunjukkan yin Hati kurang; lidah dan nadi menunjukkan yang berlebihan.
ms.principle: Tambah Hati dan Buah Pinggang, turunkan yang
ms.method: Subur air untuk melembapkan kayu, tekan yang Hati
good: Bijan hitam - menambah Hati dan Buah Pinggang
Kacang hitam - menambah yin Buah Pinggang
avoid: Makanan pedas dan panas - menghabiskan yin
Berjaga malam - menghabiskan intisari
Kopi berlebihan - mengganggu semangat
recipes: Bubur bijan hitam dan goji: 20g bijan hitam, 10g goji, 80g beras.
life: Hadkan ketegangan mata dan pandang jauh sesekali
points: Taixi (KI3) - menambah yin Buah Pinggang
Sanyinjiao (SP6) - menambah yin dan menenangkan
Taichong (LR3) - menekan yang Hati
exercise: Tai chi atau Baduanjin 20 hingga 30 minit
Berjalan perlahan, elak senaman berat
ms.emotion: Kekal tenang; emosi kuat boleh menggerakkan yang terapung.
ms.formula: Qi Ju Di Huang Wan (diubah suai)
ms.purpose: Menambah yin Hati-Buah Pinggang dan menjernihkan mata
ms.dosage: Rebus, satu dos sehari dalam dua bahagian suam
warn: Sakit kepala teruk mendadak atau penglihatan hilang
ms.note: Pesakit darah tinggi perlu memantau tekanan darah.
ms.fu_improve: Tinitus berkurang, tidur lebih baik, pinggang lebih kuat
ms.fu_next: Laras ubat menambah yin apabila pulih

zh.mech: 病后或操劳耗气伤阴，气虚则乏力气短，阴虚则口干盗汗，故见气阴两亏。
zh.cause: 久咳、热病后、长期劳累与口干饮水少。
zh.cchar: 乏力气短，口干咽燥，自汗盗汗，手足心热。
zh.ctend: 易患干咳、疲劳综合征、糖耗型消渴倾向。
zh.inquiry: 病后一直很累，稍动就气短，口干想喝水，晚上出汗，偶尔干咳。
zh.summary: 气阴两虚，既有气短乏力的气虚，又有口干盗汗的阴虚。舌红少津与细弱数脉印证二者并存。\n治以益气养阴、生津润肺，配合清润饮食与休息，通常3至4周乏力与口干改善。
zh.rationale: 气短乏力、自汗为气虚；口干盗汗、舌红少津为阴虚；脉细弱数二者兼有。
avoid: 辛辣 - 耗气伤阴
过度出汗运动 - 加重耗损
烟酒 - 伤肺阴
recipes: 沙参麦冬鸭汤：沙参15g、麦冬10g、鸭肉200g，炖1小时。
points: 太渊 - 腕横纹桡侧，按揉补肺气
足三里 - 益气健脾
照海 - 内踝下，滋阴润喉
exercise: 慢速太极或散步，不求大汗
呼吸训练，每日10分钟
zh.emotion: 放慢生活节奏，保持心境平和。
zh.formula: 生脉散合沙参麦冬汤加减
zh.dosage: 水煎服，每日一剂，分两次温服
warn: 口渴多尿体重下降（需查血糖）
zh.note: 口干多饮多尿时建议检查血糖。
zh.fu_improve: 气力渐增，口干缓解，盗汗减少
zh.fu_next: 视阴津恢复调整养阴药

en.mech: Illness and overwork consume both Qi and yin: Qi deficiency causes fatigue and shortness of breath, yin deficiency causes dry mouth and night sweats.
en.cause: Lingering cough, after febrile illness, chronic overwork and low fluid intake.
en.cchar: Fatigue, shortness of breath, dry mouth and throat, spontaneous and night sweating, hot palms and soles.
en.ctend: Prone to dry cough, fatigue syndromes and thirst-type disorders.
en.inquiry: Constantly tired since an illness, short of breath with little effort, dry mouth wanting to drink, sweat at night and an occasional dry cough.
en.tongue: Red tongue lacking fluid, thin coat.
en.face: Lustreless face with mildly flushed cheeks.
en.audio: Low, weak voice with an occasional dry cough.
en.summary: Both Qi and yin are deficient: Qi deficiency shows as fatigue and breathlessness, yin deficiency as dry mouth and night sweats. The red dry tongue and thready weak rapid pulse confirm the coexistence.\nTreatment boosts Qi, nourishes yin and generates fluids to moisten the lung, with moistening foods and rest. Fatigue and dryness usually improve in 3 to 4 weeks.
en.rationale: Breathlessness and spontaneous sweating indicate Qi deficiency; dry mouth, night sweats and a red dry tongue indicate yin deficiency; the pulse shows both.
en.principle: Boost Qi, nourish yin, generate fluids and moisten the lung
en.method: Supplement Qi and fluids, enrich yin and moisten dryness
good: Pear - moistens the lung and generates fluids
Chinese yam - boosts Qi and yin
avoid: Spicy food - consumes Qi and yin
Excessive sweating exercise - increases depletion
Smoking and alcohol - injure lung yin
recipes: Glehnia and ophiopogon duck soup: 15g glehnia, 10g ophiopogon, 200g duck, stewed 1 hour.
life: Drink small amounts of water frequently
points: Taiyuan (LU9) - radial wrist crease, press to tonify lung Qi
Zusanli (ST36) - boosts Qi and strengthens the Spleen
Zhaohai (KI6) - below the inner ankle, nourishes yin and moistens the throat
exercise: Slow tai chi or walking, avoid heavy sweating
Breathing exercises, 10 minutes daily
en.emotion: Slow down your pace of life and keep a calm mind.
en.formula: Sheng Mai San with Sha Shen Mai Dong Tang (modified)
en.purpose: Boosts Qi, nourishes yin and quenches thirst
en.dosage: Decoct, one dose daily in two warm portions
warn: Excess thirst and urination with weight loss (check blood glucose)
en.note: If thirst, polyuria and fatigue occur together, have blood glucose checked.
en.fu_improve: Gradually more strength, less dryness, fewer night sweats
en.fu_next: Adjust yin-nourishing herbs as fluids recover

ms.mech: Sakit dan keletihan menghabiskan Qi dan yin: kurang Qi menyebabkan letih dan sesak nafas, kurang yin menyebabkan mulut kering dan peluh malam.
ms.cause: Batuk lama, selepas demam, keletihan kronik dan kurang minum air.
ms.cchar: Letih, sesak nafas, mulut dan tekak kering, peluh sendiri dan peluh malam.
ms.ctend: Mudah batuk kering dan sindrom keletihan.
ms.inquiry: Sentiasa letih selepas sakit, mudah sesak nafas, mulut kering ingin minum, berpeluh malam dan kadang-kadang batuk kering.
ms.tongue: Lidah merah kurang cecair, salutan nipis.
ms.face: Muka tidak berseri, pipi sedikit kemerahan.
ms.audio: Suara perlahan dengan batuk kering sesekali.
ms.summary: Qi dan yin kedua-duanya kurang: kurang Qi menampakkan letih dan sesak nafas, kurang yin menampakkan mulut kering dan peluh malam. Lidah merah kering dan nadi halus lemah laju mengesahkan kedua-duanya.\nRawatan menambah Qi, menyuburkan yin dan menjana cecair untuk melembapkan paru-paru, bersama makanan melembap dan rehat. Keletihan dan kekeringan biasanya baik dalam 3 hingga 4 minggu.
ms.rationale: Sesak nafas dan peluh sendiri menunjukkan kurang Qi; mulut kering, peluh malam dan lidah merah kering menunjukkan kurang yin.
ms.principle: Tambah Qi, subur yin, jana cecair
ms.method: Tambah Qi dan cecair, subur yin
good: Ubi yam Cina - menambah Qi dan yin
avoid: Makanan pedas - menghabiskan Qi dan yin
Senaman berpeluh berlebihan
Rokok dan alkohol - merosakkan yin paru-paru
recipes: Sup itik glehnia dan ophiopogon: 15g glehnia, 10g ophiopogon, 200g itik, reneh 1 jam.
points: Taiyuan (LU9) - lipatan pergelangan sisi radius
Zusanli (ST36) - menambah Qi
Zhaohai (KI6) - bawah buku lali dalam, melembapkan tekak
exercise: Tai chi perlahan atau berjalan
Latihan pernafasan 10 minit sehari
ms.emotion: Perlahankan rentak hidup dan kekalkan minda tenang.
ms.formula: Sheng Mai San dengan Sha Shen Mai Dong Tang (diubah suai)
ms.purpose: Menambah Qi, menyuburkan yin dan menghilangkan dahaga
ms.dosage: Rebus, satu dos sehari dalam dua bahagian suam
warn: Dahaga dan kerap kencing dengan berat turun (semak glukosa darah)
ms.note: Jika dahaga, kerap kencing dan letih bersama, semak glukosa darah.
ms.fu_improve: Tenaga bertambah, kurang kering, peluh malam berkurang
